newsitem.title: japan: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 5.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp plans to begin testing from mid-November a video-on-demand service using the intergrated services digital network (ISDN). It will broadcast previews and other movie programmes to about 2,000 ISDN users in cooperation with Shochiku Co Ltd, Toei Co Ltd, other movie distributors and record company Nippon Columbia Co Ltd. NTT also plans to sell its data compression and server software to the companies which plan to join the video-on-demand service.

Morinaga Milk Industry Co Ltd plans to enter the home nursing business from May 1997 by offering guidance on nutrition and information on services available to people recently discharged from hospital in Shizuoka prefecture, central Japan. It hopes make the business worth three billion yen in five years.

Leading circuit sales company Japan Communication Inc has made a contract with Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp to resell leased circuits used in the open computer network (OCN) service by the end of this year.
